post.description: Public route, authenticated by the project key in the body and the Origin header. Invalid events are counted as rejected; the rest of the batch is stored. A resent event is a duplicate, never stored twice.

400.description: The body is not JSON or does not match BatchRequest.

401.description: The key is unknown or revoked; readable by the Origin that sent it, so the tracker drops the batch instead of retrying.

403.description: The Origin header is missing or not one of the project's origins (origin_not_allowed), or the project's account went past its monthly events (100% on the free plan, 150% on the paid one) and is paused until the next month (quota_exceeded), or the account is suspended for abuse (account_suspended), or the project's own reception is suspended (project_suspended). Each comes with a CORS grant to the Origin that sent it, so the tracker drops the batch; a missing or opaque Origin gets none.

429.description: Too many batches from this address or for this project.
